task: Locked Chapter Upload Modal, Dynamic Submissions Refactor, Dynamic Sidebar Badges, and Navigation Header Polish
user_intent: When a student clicks 'Revise' on a chapter requiring revision (e.g., Chapter 1), lock the upload chapter selection to that specific chapter to prevent uploading to the wrong chapter or capstone phase; refactor the submissions page to align with Phase 2 (Chapters 1-3), Phase 3 (Development Assets & Chapters 4-5), and Phase 4 (Capstone 4 Final Defense & Archival); fix bugged/hardcoded 'Draft' and '2' sidebar badges with live reactive computation; and eliminate redundant header back arrows and hamburger/sidebar collisions.

changes_made.description: Created full-featured modal dialog with initialChapter, isLocked, latestSubmission, and deadlines props. Portaled to document.body to escape CSS transform stacking context. Locks chapter select with a 'Locked for Revision' pill and warning banner when revising, renders previous review remarks, next round (vY) info, file dropzone (25MB limit), and late justification requirement if past deadline.
Added comprehensive unit tests asserting locked chapter selection, disabled dropdown, revision banner, round computation, unlocked modal chapter changing, and submission callback.
Added onUpload and onRevise prop callbacks. Triggers onRevise(chapterNumber, submission) directly on click, falling back to /submissions/upload?chapter=...&locked=true&mode=revise.
Parsed locked and mode URL search parameters, locking chapter selection when locked === 'true' and rendering a Locked for Revision badge.

Added uploadModalConfig state with handleGeneralUpload, handleCardUpload, and handleCardRevise. Wired header 'Upload Chapter' button and ChapterCard buttons to open the in-place UploadChapterModal. Refactored sections for Phase 2 (Chapters 1-3 & Proposal Document), Phase 3 (Interactive Gantt & Demo Video Assets + Chapters 4-5), and Phase 4 (Capstone 4 Final Defense & Archival with FinalPaperUpload).
Updated tests to verify Phase 2, Phase 3, Phase 4 sections, and Upload Chapter triggers.

Replaced static studentNavItems with dynamic getStudentNavItems(badges). Submissions badge computes actionable count (pending revisions + missing development assets). My Capstone badge renders dynamic state ('Archived', 'Active', 'Draft'). Added emerald 'success' variant for Active. Fixed sidebar header spacing with px-3.5 py-3 gap-2, min-w-0 flex-1 pr-1 on title, shrink-0 on COT tag, and shrink-0 ml-auto on collapse toggle button to eliminate collisions.
Added tests verifying dynamic badge transitions (Draft -> Active -> Archived, and action required count calculations).
Removed /project/submissions from getBackDestination to eliminate redundant back arrow; added md:hidden to mobile hamburger button to eliminate duplicate desktop expanders.

verification_evidence.client_targeted_tests: 30 / 30 passed across layout, submissions, and modal test suites
verification_evidence.playwright_visual_audit: 5 visual screenshots captured and verified across desktop light/dark, collapsed sidebar, and mobile viewports

lessons_learned: CSS Transform Stacking Context with Fixed Modals: In DashboardLayout.jsx, the route enter animation uses CSS transform, creating a new local stacking context. Fixed overlay dialogs must use ReactDOM.createPortal(..., document.body) to guarantee viewport centering.
Dynamic Sidebar Badge Fallbacks: Nav badges that rely on query hooks must provide sensible fallbacks when stores/queries are uninitialized or in unit test mock environments.

Actionable Items Counting: Defining actionable items as pending revisions plus missing milestone assets (e.g. Gantt or demo video) provides students with clear guidance on what requires immediate attention.
